name: newer_doc_wins
description: Two versions of a guide disagree; the newer one says it replaces the older limit.

input.question: What is the current Loomstack API rate limit per key?

sources.guide-2023.md:
# Loomstack guide (March 2023)

The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute per key.
sources.guide-2025.md:
# Loomstack guide (June 2025)

The API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per key. This replaces the earlier limit of 100 requests per minute.
